name: django
description: Django 6.1 transaction.atomic() through the PostgreSQL backend and psycopg 3. Category C faults are withheld or rewritten in this process, before psycopg sends the statement. Native mode is CONN_MAX_AGE 0. TX-03 runs only in the persistent mode (CONN_MAX_AGE null), because the default closes the connection at the end of each request.

modes.description: Django's documented default: transaction.atomic() for the outer transaction and a nested transaction.atomic() for the savepoint, PostgreSQL backend, psycopg 3, CONN_MAX_AGE 0, no connection pool. TX-03 is not run in this mode. The default closes the database connection at the end of each request (not-applicable-by-design for handing a transactionally active connection to later work). https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/6.1/ref/databases/#persistent-connections
CONN_MAX_AGE null, Django's unlimited persistent connections. Between the two units, the adapter calls django.db.close_old_connections(), the handler request_finished runs. No connection pool.

TX-04.independent-inner.reason: Django has no propagation mode that promises an independent transaction. A nested transaction.atomic() is a savepoint on the same connection. Model.objects.create sends the INSERT when it is called, so a nested scope has no pending outer writes it could commit. The hazard TX-04.3 targets cannot arise.
